subject.title: Add a bottom-origin virtualizing chat layout

question: Should Reactor adopt a custom bottom-origin virtualizing layout as the supported cross-host chat foundation, rather than first narrowing the existing layout and follow-policy behavior?
rationale: The request introduces a new low-level rendering architecture and strict implementation constraints across hosts; source-level confirmation of the existing supported path and maintainer intent are needed before selecting the permanent design.

options.title: Authorize a focused layout investigation
options.body: Create a small design and characterization effort that compares the existing Reactor path with a custom bottom-origin layout before committing to the replacement.

options.title: Narrow the request to follow behavior
options.body: Keep the current layout and address only reproducible initial-positioning or stream-follow defects through a smaller supported scroll-policy change.

options.title: Defer the custom layout
options.body: Leave the feature parked until a maintainer confirms that cross-host chat virtualization is a current product priority.

recommendation.title: Authorize a focused layout investigation
recommendation.body: Create a small design and characterization effort that compares the existing Reactor path with a custom bottom-origin layout before committing to the replacement.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter supplied the only concrete subsystem and acceptance-criteria context available to this review; repository history could not be inspected to identify a stronger current-main owner.
